hotspots.name: Hearth Ashes
hotspots.description: The inn hearth burns low under damp pine. Someone has raked the ash smooth, then disturbed it again with boot heels and a short knife-tip mark shaped like three cuts across a road line.

hotspots.name: Back Table Manifest
hotspots.description: A rain-warped table holds spilled ale, candle grease, and a copied caravan tally. One passenger line has been overwritten twice, but the pressure marks remain in the wood beneath the paper.
